source_origin.work: William Playfair, The Commercial and Political Atlas (London, 1786): Exports and Imports to and from Denmark & Norway from 1700 to 1780

data.method: Gridlines calibrated on the scan; each line traced column by column by colour, then sampled at every year.
data.precision: Readings of a hand-engraved, hand-coloured plate; treat as about ±1 unit.

checked: Curves and both balance areas are drawn only from data.csv; the redraw overlays the engraved lines across 1700-1780.
Exports overtake imports between 1754 and 1755, as on the plate.
Grid, frame, axis labels, title, caption and imprint placed at measured scan positions; overlay checked at 2067 px.
Spaced capitals keep letter gaps under 0.13 em, so DENMARK, NORWAY and ENGLAND extract as whole words.
Structural audit: 0 issues, 0 warnings; both fonts embedded (review/audit.json).
editorial_decisions: Engraved lettering set in Libre Caslon Text; heavier engraved capitals approximated with a thin stroke.
Old-style figures and the superscripts in '1st' and 'Wm.' set as lining figures and ordinary letters.
Curve labels are set letter by letter along their lines, so their extracted text order is approximate.
